game.title: SPARE CHANGE
game.subtitle: A Street Life Simulator
game.tagline: You don't choose where you fall. You only choose what you do next.
title.seedHint: Leave empty for a random life
title.how1: You're rolled into a random life on the streets of one of 15 real cities.
title.how2: Each day has Morning, Afternoon and Night. Pick one action in each.
title.how3: Survive, find people, and maybe find a way out. Every life ends differently.
title.disclaimer: City weights are rough approximations of street populations, for gameplay only.
panel.empty: Nothing but the clothes you're wearing.
skip.strategy: How do you want to live it?
skip.safeDesc: Avoid trouble, save money, low heat.
skip.riskyDesc: Best spots, labor, gambling. High heat.
summary.title: {days} days later…
summary.none: The days blurred together. Nothing remarkable — which is sometimes a good thing.
summary.stopped: Something important happened — you need to decide.
ended.title: This life has ended
lock.phase: Not at this time of day
lock.notFlag.lost_contact: You've lost contact — try the NGO's family tracing
lock.family: You have no family to call
milestone.first_shelter: First night in a shelter bed
log.start: You open your eyes on a sidewalk in {city}. A new day — your first like this.
log.coldNight: The cold bit deep last night.
log.stormNight: The storm soaked everything you own.
log.noSleep: You didn't sleep. Your body notices.
log.sick: You wake up feverish and aching.
log.recovered: The fever's gone. You feel human again.
tl.start: Began life on the streets of {city}, age {age}
tl.room: Rented a room with your own key
res.gamble.jackpot: JACKPOT! The whole circle groans as you scoop the pile.
res.gamble.win: You win the hand and double your stake.
res.gamble.lose: You lose {amount}. The dice don't care.
res.sleep.shelter: A real bed tonight. Clean sheets. A door.
res.sleep.room: You sleep in your own room.
res.wash.cold: Ice-cold water in this weather. Brr.
res.ngo.bed: You got a bed for tonight!
res.ngo.medic: The volunteer medic patched you up.
res.ngo.paperwork: A caseworker pushed your ID paperwork forward.
res.dog.adopt: Today the dog follows you home — wherever home is. You call it {dog}.
res.dog.progress: The dog is warming up to you ({n}/3).
res.dog.play: {dog} is the happiest creature in the city.
res.call.warm: Their voice cracks when they hear you. You talk for a long time.
res.call.hard: It's a short, painful call. Some wounds take time.
res.id.dirty: The clerk wrinkles her nose and says to come back cleaner.
res.id.fee: The final step needs a {amount} fee. Come back when you have it.
res.id.fail1: Office closed early. Come back tomorrow.
res.id.fail2: Wrong form. Different window. Back of the line.
res.id.fail3: The system is down. Of course it is.
res.move: Welcome to {city}. Nobody knows you here — yet.
end.title: Your Life
end.note: Behind every number in this game is a real person somewhere. If you can, support your local shelters and street outreach.
end.shareText: I lived {days} days on the streets of {city} {flag} in SPARE CHANGE. Ending: {ending} ({rarity}). “{line}”

lb.sending: Verifying this life with the server…
lb.breakdown: days {days} + got off the street {escape} + kindness {kindness} × city difficulty {mult}
lb.offline: Online features are unavailable right now — the game still works normally.
lb.invalid: This life can’t go on the leaderboard (it may have started before scores existed).
lb.error.name: Name must be 1–20 characters
lb.empty: Nobody on this board yet — be the first!
lb.howScore: Score = (days survived × 10 + escape bonus by ending rarity + friends/help/meals shared) × difficulty of your starting city. Every score is verified by the server replaying your life from its seed.
